A strong economy starts in the neighborhoods where people live. Accessible and affordable housing helps people put down roots, build wealth and support their communities. Yet rising costs and limited housing supply are putting homeownership and housing stability out of reach for many. Through the American Dream Initiative, JPMorganChase is working to expand opportunity by helping increase housing supply, supporting homeownership and scaling local solutions that help the economy work for more people.


Lasting progress starts at the local level. That's why we support organizations with deep roots in their communities and firsthand knowledge of residents’ needs. By working with local organizations and helping build their capacity, we can help advance solutions tailored to local needs and create lasting impact. Watch our video about how our philanthropic support for Reclaiming Chicago is helping create new pathways to homeownership for families across Chicago.
